verdict.rationale: Elastic documents per-request distributed tracing through APM, APM-agent metric collection, and a platform that unifies logs, metrics and traces, so the pieces for end-to-end debugging exist in one product. However, no evidence describes navigating from a specific trace span to its correlated logs and metrics. The 'surface correlations' claim refers to anomaly and root-cause analysis, not span-level linking. missing for 10: documented span-to-logs navigation, documented span-to-metrics navigation, trace/log ID correlation mechanics, hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end debugging flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end

citations.quote: Unify logs, metrics, traces, user experience data
Elastic APM traces every request across microservices and APIs pinpointing code-level latency.
Elastic APM agents automatically pick up basic host-level metrics and agent-specific metrics
